title: Pet Insurance for Travelers (US)
note: Facts only from each insurer's own website or sample policy, read 2026-10-24. 'check' lists fields we could not confirm or where the insurer's pages disagree or vary by state/carrier. No prices, no rankings.

insurers.name: Spot
insurers.territory: United States, its territories (Guam, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands) and Canada. Care elsewhere is not covered.
insurers.waiting: 14 days for accidents and illnesses, including knee and ligament conditions. Preventive care (optional) starts the next day.
insurers.age: From 8 weeks. No upper age limit.
insurers.extra: Curable conditions cured and free of treatment and symptoms for 180 days are no longer treated as pre-existing (not knee or ligament conditions).

insurers.name: Pets Best
insurers.territory: United States, Canada, and regions under US government control, such as territories or US military bases in other countries.
insurers.waiting: In the Virginia sample policy: 3 days for injuries, 14 days for illnesses, 6 months for cruciate ligament events. Pets Best says waiting periods vary by state.
insurers.age: From 7 weeks. No upper age limit.
insurers.extra: Optional Vet Direct Pay sends the covered amount straight to the vet.
sources: Sample policy, Virginia (Treatment locations, Waiting periods)

insurers.name: Trupanion
insurers.territory: United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, plus US and Canadian territories and military bases worldwide. Care elsewhere is not covered. (The sample policy PDF says only the US or Canada.)
insurers.waiting: 5 days for injuries, 30 days for illnesses.
insurers.age: Enroll before the pet's 14th birthday. Coverage then continues for life.
insurers.reimb: Up to 90% of eligible costs, with no payout limits.
insurers.extra: Many US and Canadian vets can be paid directly by Trupanion.

insurers.name: Lemonade
insurers.territory: Any licensed vet in the United States, even in a state where Lemonade isn't sold. Treatment outside the US is not covered (this includes Canada).
insurers.waiting: 14 days for illnesses, 30 days for orthopedic conditions. Depending on your state, Lemonade lists 0 or 2 days for accidents and 6 months for cruciate ligament events.
insurers.extra: Sold in 41 states and DC (per Lemonade's FAQ).

insurers.name: Odie
insurers.territory: United States or Canada (FAQ). The sample policy covers Canada only for temporary stays of 90 days or less and pays in US dollars.
insurers.waiting: Depends on the underwriting carrier and your state: 0 to 15 days for injuries, 14 to 15 days for illnesses, and up to 6 months for cruciate ligament events on one product.
insurers.age: Depends on the product: from 7 weeks with no upper limit, or 8 weeks to 14 years.
insurers.extra: Odie sells policies from more than one insurance company, so read the policy you are offered.

insurers.name: Fetch
insurers.territory: Any licensed vet in the United States or Canada, including during a trip.
insurers.waiting: Up to 15 days. Fetch's pages differ on accidents: the Help Center gives 15 days for injury and illness; the reimbursement page says accidents have no waiting period. 6-month exclusion for hip dysplasia, cruciates and patellas (the knee period can be waived with a vet exam).
insurers.age: From 6 weeks. No upper age limit.
insurers.extra: Lists cover for canceled vacation costs if your pet gets sick or injured before or during a trip (read the policy for limits).

insurers.name: Healthy Paws
insurers.territory: United States, and Canada only while you are temporarily traveling there.
insurers.waiting: 15 days for accidents and illnesses. 12 months for hip dysplasia if enrolled at age 5 or under. Several states have different rules.
insurers.age: From 8 weeks. Upper age limit: Check.
insurers.extra: Optional direct payment to any licensed US vet on covered claims.

insurers.name: Embrace
insurers.territory: Embrace says travel with your pet is covered for up to 6 consecutive months per trip, including outside the US and Canada.
insurers.waiting: 14 days for illnesses. Accidents are covered from the policy effective date. Some states also have orthopedic waiting periods.
insurers.age: Accident and illness plans: under 15. Pets 15 and older: accident-only plan. Minimum age: Check.
insurers.extra: We found the international wording on an Embrace comparison page, not in a policy document: confirm with Embrace before you rely on it.

insurers.name: Pumpkin
insurers.territory: Any licensed vet in the United States or Canada. Care in other countries: Check.
insurers.waiting: 14 days or less for all conditions, including knee injuries and hip dysplasia.
insurers.age: From 8 weeks. No upper age limit.

insurers.name: ASPCA Pet Health Insurance
insurers.territory: Any licensed vet in the United States or Canada. Care in other countries: Check.

insurers.name: Nationwide
insurers.territory: Any licensed vet, anywhere in the world (Nationwide FAQ). The buyer's guide says the same applies "in the U.S. or abroad".
insurers.waiting: Most plans start 14 days after your application is approved and payment is received.
insurers.age: Enrollment ages: Check. Cats 8 and older cannot enroll in hereditary coverage.
insurers.reimb: Depends on the plan: some pay a percentage, others pay set benefit amounts. Check.
